text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh! Haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I-Incredible—so this is the Twinkle 
Series...!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(It was completely different from seeing 
it on screen... The heat, the sheer 
power...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I still have to keep trying my 
best...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while tossed about by the rough waves 
of the Twinkle Series... Dantsu Flame was 
able to give it her all in a truly solid 
debut race!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: A route for the Classic year, you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Upon entering the Classic Year, the path 
splits broadly into two. The glorious 
Triple Crown route running through the 
Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby), and Kikuka Sho—and..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara route centers around 
glamorous races such as the Oka Sho, the 
Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
According to the exchange of information 
with fellow trainers, the theory that 
Agnes Tachyon, Jungle Pocket, and others 
will pursue the Triple Crown route seems 
most likely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With that in mind, I wanted to ask your 
preference beforehand regarding which path 
you wish to pursue."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-chan and the others are heading 
for the Triple Crown... I see, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I-I—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want to take on the Triple Crown route 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I feel like if I'm aiming to be the 
"protagonist," the classic Triple Crown 
route is the way to go...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If Tachyon-chan and the others are there, 
I don't think it'll be an easy win, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Still, I want to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take on the prep race properly, and 
give it my absolute all, fully serious, in 
my own way for the Classic series...!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: W-What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If anything, with such strong ambition, I 
definitely want to take on the Triple 
Crown path.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, the competitors we'll 
clash with are all outstanding talents 
already making a name for themselves."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For our tentative target race, I'll 
propose the Spring Classic prep race... 
the turf 1,800m GIII 'Kisaragi Sho', but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For a while until then, she should focus 
on training and strive to improve her 
abilities."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You're certainly right about 
that—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(If possible, I'd like to get experience 
at a variety of racetracks, but...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Still, races take a lot of stamina and 
mental energy, don't they? If I consider 
the time needed to recover from that... 
maybe focusing on training would be...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! Um—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A training-focused rotation, got it! I'll 
do my best. Tachyon-chan and the others—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: S... so that I can win!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmm, I'm so full...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Right, while Trainer's away, I should 
check the route to our lodging...)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Did something happen around 
there today? There seems to be quite a 
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, they were holding Twinkle Series races 
over at the racecourse today, you see.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, really? The Twinkle Series, huh... I 
think I've heard of it."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, the girls who are running just 
look so radiant, don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Were you watching? Did you have a friend 
in the race?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, uuummm...—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (...Well, whatever.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. That's pretty much it~.

Our next target race was the Kisaragi Sho— 
And so, the days of building up strength 
for the upcoming Classic campaign began.
